context.title: League of Women Voters of California — November 3, 2026 general election recommendations

of.name: League of Women Voters of California

positions.statement: LWV-CA is a co-sponsor of SB 42 (Umberg-Allen-Cervantes-Lee), the legislative vehicle that placed this measure on the November 2026 ballot, and urges a Yes vote to (per LWV-CA's stated reason) 'lift the ban on public campaign financing in California and help ensure that everyday Californians, not just wealthy special interests, have a meaningful voice in our elections.'
